description: Compute the lawyer's fee (حق‌الوکاله) for a financial claim under the Bar tariff: the tiered amount on the claim's value and each stage's share, for the number of lawyers — the figure a court awards against the losing side. Use it when the question is the tariff fee or whether an agreed fee is above it; for the stamp on the power of attorney use calculate_stamp_duty, and for court fees calculate_court_fee. Returns the fee in rial per stage with its breakdown and the tariff's articles. Amounts in rial; dates in the Jalali calendar.

agreed_fee_rial.description: The fee agreed in the contract, in rial, to compare with the tariff.

amount_rial.description: The claim's value, or the judgment sum at enforcement, in rial.

final_judgment.description: At first instance: the judgment cannot be appealed because the claim is small (Civil Procedure Code 331).

lawyers.description: Number of lawyers; 1 when not given.

stage.description: Stage of the case; first when not given. Values: first = مرحله نخستین (بدوی); appeal = تجدیدنظر; supreme = فرجام (دیوان عالی کشور); enforcement = اجرای احکام.

name: calculate_lawyer_fee

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.

title: Lawyer's fee by tariff (حق‌الوکاله)
